integrity.first_public_date_basis: arXiv:0807.3163 was first submitted on 2008-07-20 and gives the archive-era toric discriminant degree framework; its first listed MSC is 14M25.

scientific_limitations: Smooth complex projective toric surfaces with complete toric embeddings only.
The dual-degree excess is defined only for nondefective embeddings whose projective dual is a hypersurface.
The genus-zero linearly embedded projective plane is dual defective and is excluded.
An unindexed classical source could contain the same fixed-genus corollary of the standard discriminant formula.
title: Triangular-genus dips in the dual-degree excess of smooth toric surfaces
